definition.title: Sample: round phases, a network migration
definition.summary: Northwind moves its Harbor site to a new core. Each phase goes on its own. Phase A blocks B and C, and step A2 blocks B3.

phases.title: Prepare
phases.goal: Everything is ready before anyone touches the network.

phases.title: Cut over
phases.goal: Traffic runs through the new core.

phases.title: Retire
phases.goal: The old core is off and gone.

body.p: Nothing else changes on the core until phase C closes.

items.title: Log in to every core device

body.p: Three devices at Quay refused the login: 198.51.100.31, .32 and .33. Generate an email to whoever can grant access.

items.title: Move VLAN 120 to the new core
Swap the core addresses in DNS

body.p: Can't happen until step A2 is answered, whatever else is open.

items.title: Every branch reaches the file share
Voice calls hold for ten minutes

A2.note: sw-harbor-2 looks wrong, and Quay is missing a switch

reply.text: Re-verified against the live switches. sw-harbor-2 moved to 192.0.2.14 and sw-quay-2 was missing.

email.ask: Check the updated switch list before Friday's freeze
email.subject: Access switch inventory changed: please check by Friday
email.body:
Hi all,

We re-verified the access switch inventory for the Harbor move against the live switches, and two things changed:

- sw-harbor-2 is at 192.0.2.14, not 192.0.2.12
- sw-quay-2 at 192.0.2.22 was missing, and is now on the list

Could you check the updated list before Friday's freeze?

Thanks.

email.subject: Switch inventory changed: check by Friday
email.body:
Hi all,

Re-verifying the inventory changed two things: sw-harbor-2 is now 192.0.2.14, and sw-quay-2 (192.0.2.22) was added. Please check the list before Friday's freeze.

Thanks.
